base.role: replica record-geometry computation (Section 10.4), as called in local eligibility (Section 10.6)

every_other_rule_holds: Image level is impossible: the frame's row counts are validated against the payload slots, which must all decode (Section 10.6), and against the device-measured record count. A replica consistent with s = 2^58 would need 2^64 payload bytes, and its covered count would have to equal s. This is why the parent was refused on count and scope grounds first.
quotes: Every size formula of Section 10.4 evaluates without overflow, and the recorded geometry fields equal its results.
